# Yajurved Construction Pvt. Ltd.

> Construction, housing society redevelopment, property title verification, MahaRERA registration support, property litigation consultancy and real estate financial consultancy in Nashik, Maharashtra, India. Founded in 2025.

## Services

- [Construction & Society Redevelopment in Nashik](https://www.yajurvedrealestate.com/services/redevelopment-nashik): feasibility, member consent, developer selection, NMC approvals under UDCPR, construction
- [Property Title Verification](https://www.yajurvedrealestate.com/services/property-title-verification): 30-year title search, 7/12 extract, mutation entries, encumbrance search, documentation
- [MahaRERA Registration](https://www.yajurvedrealestate.com/services/maharera-registration): eligibility, documents, project bank account, quarterly progress reports
- [Property Litigation Consultancy](https://www.yajurvedrealestate.com/services/property-litigation-consultancy): title, partition, encroachment, redevelopment and builder-delay disputes
- [Real Estate Financial Consultancy](https://www.yajurvedrealestate.com/services/financial-consultancy): feasibility models, self-redevelopment loans, corpus planning, GST and income tax
